info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Strategy Management API
info.description: The Product Strategy Management API facilitates the dynamic updating of product strategies within a banking context. It allows users to modify existing strategies to adapt to changing market conditions or business objectives. Typical consumers include product managers and business analysts looking to optimize their product offerings and align them with corporate goals. This API is essential for maintaining competitiveness and ensuring that product development aligns with strategic business direction.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of the product strategy identified by PROD-700045. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request.
